changelog:
mano-cua-a 1.0.0

- Initial release of mano-cua: desktop GUI automation using VLA models.
- Enables natural language-driven automation for apps without API/CLI support.
- Supports both fully on-device local mode (Apple Silicon/macOS) and secure cloud mode.
- Task execution restricted to visible foreground app/window; agent only sees/interacts with the primary display.
- Includes safety features: single-task limit, real-time status panel, user confirmation for sensitive actions.
- Full privacy controls: no background monitoring, no persistent data storage, and local mode ensures that no data leaves the device.
